A small ball starts from rest and undergoes free-fall motion, reaching the ground after 5 seconds.

1. What is the height of the small ball above the ground when it falls?
2. What is the magnitude of the velocity of the ball when it hits the ground?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A small ball starts from rest and undergoes free-fall motion, reaching the ground after 5 seconds. 1. What is the height of the small ball above the ground when it falls? 2. What is the magnitude of the velocity of the ball when it hits the ground?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given free fall from rest: initial velocity u = 0, time t = 5 s, and acceleration due to gravity g = 9.8 m/s^2 downward. The drop height is s = ut + (1/2)gt^2 = 0·5 + (1/2)(9.8)(5^2) = 4.9·25 = 122.5 m. The impact speed magnitude is v = u + gt = 0 + 9.8·5 = 49 m/s.
